params.name: search
params.description:
Filter templates using RSQL syntax. Combine expressions with `;` (AND) or `,` (OR).

**Filterable fields:**

| Field | Type | Operators |
|-------|------|-----------|
| `name` | string | `==` `!=` `=in=` `=out=` `=regex=` `=contains=` |
| `created_at` | date | `==` `!=` `=in=` `=out=` `=gt=` `=ge=` `=lt=` `=le=` |
| `updated_at` | date | `==` `!=` `=in=` `=out=` `=gt=` `=ge=` `=lt=` `=le=` |
| `entity_id` | string | `==` `!=` `=in=` `=out=` `=regex=` |

**Examples:**
- `name==MyTemplate;entity_id==a6b45428-0296-4394-8ddd-0b50b5b20aa9`
- `name==TemplateName`

params.name: order_by
params.description: The ordering sequence of the selected templates If not selected then Descending order is the default order.

params.name: page_number
params.description: A filter query in RSQL format to retrieve templates based on page number. If not selected then a default pageNumber is 1.

params.name: page_size
params.description: A filter query in RSQL format to retrieve templates based on page size. If not selected then a default pageSize is 50
